Identify the area with the highest percentage of workers in vulnerable employment, from
Source 1.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Identify two benefits of good working conditions, from Source 2.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Which benefit of good working conditions do you think is the most important? Explain why.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Explain why working conditions are an important national issue.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
‘Older people should continue to work.’
What are the strengths and weaknesses of the argument supporting this claim?

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
‘Older people do not use social media as much as young people.’
How could you test this claim? You may consider the types of information, sources of evidence
or methods you might use.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Identify one prediction from Susanna’s statement.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Explain why Susanna’s statement might be biased.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Which argument is more convincing, Susanna’s or Ryan’s?
Your answer should consider both arguments and you should support your point of view with
their words.
You should also consider:
• the strength of their reasoning and evidence
• their use of language
• the different types of information used.

text: ‘People should be allowed to work at any age.’ Do you agree with this statement?
• give reasons to support your opinion
• use the material in the sources and/or any of your own ideas
